statement: The system MUST require applicable design phases to record a topic-specific testing strategy before planning begins, including languages, application/change type, existing test tools, consulted docs/best practices, unit strategy, integration strategy, E2E strategy, and at least one E2E validation that must run at least once.
title: Design-phase testing strategy

statement: The system MUST require every feature/change topic to design at least one E2E validation that runs at least once before acceptance, with the strategy deciding whether it is recurring CI, one-time validation, or manual-assisted evidence.
title: At least one E2E validation

statement: The system MUST require plan validation items for behavior-changing phases to name specific test artifacts, scenarios, or commands that must be created, updated, and pass; generic validation language such as only 'run tests' is insufficient.
title: Plan validation names concrete tests

statement: The system MUST build on existing project test tools by default and MUST ask the user before requiring a major testing-tool pivot or upgrade. When a testing strategy would add, remove, replace, or standardize a major testing framework/tool for the project, the workflow MUST trigger ADR evaluation/generation before implementation planning treats that toolchain change as accepted.
title: Existing-tool preservation and user-approved pivots

description: A TypeScript frontend design records existing tools, derives component/integration and E2E strategy, cites applicable docs, and names at least one browser E2E validation.
title: TypeScript frontend feature

description: A Python CLI or system tool plan names focused pytest or subprocess tests using temporary roots/filesystems and includes at least one real command smoke path.
title: Python CLI/system tool feature

description: A Jest-to-Vitest or similar recommendation is treated as a user-owned decision before implementation planning requires it, and accepted project testing-tool changes trigger ADR evaluation/generation.
title: Tool pivot recommendation

description: A behavior-changing plan phase with only generic 'run tests' validation is incomplete until focused test artifacts/scenarios and pass commands are named.
title: Plan rejects generic validation
